topic.readerProblem: Find out what Profound actually costs now that its public price list has changed, and decide whether an enterprise-quoted AI visibility platform is worth it for a small business.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer choosing between a one-off AI visibility baseline, self-serve trackers and an enterprise monitoring platform.

assessment: The page reports what Profound's pricing page showed on 2026-10-03 (free 7-day Trial, quote-only Enterprise, agency add-ons at $399 and $199 per month) and flags that the Starter $99 and Growth $399 plans quoted elsewhere, including our September 23 version, are no longer listed. It computes only what the published inputs allow, labels the arithmetic as such, and gives a small-business decision rule. It does not claim hands-on use, does not estimate an Enterprise price, and does not judge product quality.

sources.supports: Trial (free, 50 prompts daily for 7 days, ChatGPT/Gemini/Google AI Overviews), Enterprise (custom, up to 9 engines, API, exports, SSO), agency plans and add-ons ($399/month per client workspace, $199/month for 5 trial workspaces), credits FAQ, unlimited seats.
Profound captures front-end experiences and runs every tracked prompt daily because AI platforms do not return the same answer twice.
What Profound Agents do (content cycle automation), as the second pricing meter.
Otterly Lite $29/month (15 prompts, 4 engines), Standard $189/month (100 prompts), 15% annual discount.
Peec AI Starter $95/month on the monthly toggle (50 prompts, choose 3 models, daily tracking).
12 prompts run 60-100 times each; under 1-in-100 chance ChatGPT or Google AI repeats the same brand list; visibility percentage across repeated runs is a more reasonable metric than rank.
